key_points.text: How exactly did Sega manage to go from having over half the video game console market in the US with the Sega Genesis to abandoning the console business entirely after Dreamcast in a few short years?.
key_points.evidence_quote: How exactly did Sega manage to go from having over half the video game console market in the US with the Sega Genesis to abandoning the console business entirely after Dreamcast in a few short years?

thesis: The episode examines the decline of Sega from a dominant market leader to abandoning the console business entirely, focusing on the strategic error of pursuing CD-ROM add-ons for existing consoles rather than releasing new hardware. The hosts argue that this approach created a death spiral by limiting the software market to a small installed base, which discouraged developers from creating best-in-class games and caused consumer interest to wane.
